answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking tied to identity: before an agent can transact, it must lock refundable collateral. This makes fake identities costly, so a whisper of throwaway bots collapses under capital strain. Spread staked reputation across an atlas of peer attestations, then filter every claim through a prism of independent verifiers. Only identities surviving both the economic bond and cross-checking earn standing, starving sybils of cheap scale.
